RCS-28873 — Starbucks Coffee Company (NA): Multiple Searches Showing Error Message, General Slowness in Search Results

Prepared: 10 September 2026 | Analyst: Sebastian Rueda | Status: WORK IN PROGRESS

1. Ticket Details

Field

Value

Ticket

RCS-28873

Customer

Starbucks Coffee Company (NA)

Issue Type

Incident

Priority

High

Status

WORK IN PROGRESS

Opened

10 September 2026

Reporter

Nancy Sciascia (nsciasci@starbucks.com)

Assignee

Sebastian Rueda (srueda@apprissretail.com)

Jira URL

https://trebuco.atlassian.net/browse/RCS-28873

2. Problem Statement

In addition to Star Rewards searches, the Store Details search shows an error message ("Sorry but we couldn't process your search"), and Transaction Viewer is loading very slowly. Multiple searches appear to be impacted.

3. Client Profile

Field

Value

Client ID

c166_sbx (US)

ARDM version

N/A — not on SnowTime; legacy pyardm

Snowflake schema

ARDMPROD.ARDM_166

Active products

Secure search/reporting; no SnowTime cutover

4. Investigation

4.1 Error log analysis

Query: Reviewed error logs supplied by operator.

POINT OF FAILURE FOUND. Two distinct Snowflake errors: invalid identifier 'T2.X_STOREMANAGER' (SQL compilation, 42000) and Numeric value '1931449134107160' is not recognized (22018/100038).

4.2 Client cutover status check

Query: Checked prior-ticket memory for c166_sbx cutover status.

PASS. Confirmed c166_sbx has no SnowTime cutover — exists only in ARDM_LAB_PRODUCTION (lab, no real build). Live app reads legacy ARDMPROD.ARDM_166.

4.3 Physical column verification — STOREMANAGER

Query:

SELECT TABLE_NAME, COLUMN_NAME, DATA_TYPE
FROM ARDMPROD.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS
WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA='ARDM_166' AND COLUMN_NAME ILIKE '%STOREMANAGER%'

POINT OF FAILURE FOUND. Column exists as REFERENCE_LOCATION_EXT.STOREMANAGER (TEXT), with no X_ prefix. The Store Details search generates SQL referencing T2.X_STOREMANAGER, which does not exist — direct cause of the "invalid identifier" error.

4.4 Physical column verification — MEMBERID

Query:

SELECT TABLE_NAME, COLUMN_NAME, DATA_TYPE, NUMERIC_PRECISION, NUMERIC_SCALE
FROM ARDMPROD.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS
WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA='ARDM_166' AND COLUMN_NAME ILIKE '%MEMBERID%'

PASS (rules out physical column as cause). ARDM_LOYALTYCARD_EXT.MEMBERID and ARDM_ITEMDISCOUNT_EXT.MEMBERID are both NUMBER(38,0) — ample precision for the reported 16-digit value. The overflow error is not a physical-column limitation; it points to an implicit cast to a lower-precision NUMBER elsewhere in the search/parameter definition.

4.5 Storage migration timing check

Query:

SELECT TABLE_NAME, CREATED, LAST_ALTERED, ROW_COUNT, BYTES
FROM ARDMPROD.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES
WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA='ARDM_166'
  AND TABLE_NAME IN ('ARDM_LOYALTYCARD_EXT','REFERENCE_LOCATION_EXT','ARDM_HEADER','ARDM_HEADER_EXT')

PASS (rules out recent migration). All relevant tables CREATED 2024-04-26 — the Greenplum→Snowflake storage move is not recent. LAST_ALTERED 2026-08-27/28 reflects normal daily load activity, not a schema migration event.

4.6 Secure catalog / git trace

Query: Searched Secure repository git history and code for X_STOREMANAGER, X_MEMBERID, and recent commits touching c166/sbx.

No matches found. Confirms these field/search definitions are user/system-authored in secure.Repo (Platform DB, SQL Server), not git-tracked.

5. Root Cause Statement

Field

Detail

What broke

Multiple Secure searches for c166_sbx (Store Details, Star Rewards MemberID search/drilldown, Transaction Viewer) failing or degraded

Why

Secure's field catalog/search definitions reference field names and casts that no longer match the physical Snowflake schema of legacy ARDMPROD.ARDM_166 — an X_-prefixed field name (X_STOREMANAGER) with no physical X_ prefix (STOREMANAGER), plus a numeric cast/precision issue on the MemberID parameter. Catalog-desync bug-class, not a data or migration issue — storage has been stable since 2024-04-26

Scope

c166_sbx (Starbucks NA). Related RCS-28848 (opened one day earlier, same client) reports the same failure class

Business impact

Multiple customer-facing searches broken/degraded; general search slowness (Transaction Viewer)

Evidence

REFERENCE_LOCATION_EXT.STOREMANAGER confirmed with no X_ prefix; MEMBERID columns confirmed NUMBER(38,0); table CREATED timestamps rule out a recent migration

6. Additional Findings

RCS-28848 (opened 2026-09-09, same client) reports: Star Reward Transaction MemberID search failing with the same error class, "2-Stars Accrued by MemberID" drilldown failing, and Star accrual/redemption data missing retroactively from previously-correct transactions. Ticket reassigned to the same reviewer (Sebastian Rueda) as likely related root cause.

7. Recommended Fix

Option A — Secure field catalog resync (Recommended)

Locate the Secure Platform DB (secure.Repo, SQL Server) definitions for the affected searches (Store Details field catalog / extension mapping for Reference_Location_Ext; Star Rewards MemberID search parameter). Confirm the declared field mapping/cast against the actual Snowflake physical schema and correct the mismatch (remove erroneous X_ prefix mapping for StoreManager; fix MemberID parameter precision/cast). Requires access to Secure's Platform DB (SQL Server) — not available from the SnowTime/Snowflake tooling used in this investigation.

Escalation note: this bug-class (Secure field catalog desynced from the physical schema) is owned by Delivery, not Engineering, per prior precedent — recommend escalating there once the SQL Server-side confirmation is done.

8. Open Questions

  • Confirm via secure.Repo lookup the exact declared mapping for X_STOREMANAGER and the MemberID parameter precision (needs SQL Server / Platform DB access).

  • Confirm whether RCS-28848's "stars missing retroactively" symptom shares the same root cause or is a separate data issue.

  • Confirm escalation target (Delivery) once catalog mismatch is verified.

9. Queries Run

#

Query

Environment

Snowflake (ARDMPROD, US)

REFERENCE_LOCATION_EXT.STOREMANAGER, TEXT — no X_ prefix

2

Snowflake (ARDMPROD, US)

ARDM_LOYALTYCARD_EXT.MEMBERID / ARDM_ITEMDISCOUNT_EXT.MEMBERID, both NUMBER(38,0)

3

RCS-28873 / RCS-28848 — c166/sbx Secure search failures: root cause + fix

c166_sbx cut over from legacy pyardm to SnowTime on 2026-08-27 and has been live in production since (task actively running). The Store Details "invalid identifier 'T2.X_STOREMANAGER'" error and the Star Rewards MemberID "Numeric value not recognized" error are both Secure field-catalog desyncs following that migration, not SnowTime pipeline or data defects — underlying ARDM data is intact in both cases.

Root causes, verified directly against the live ARDM_PRODUCTION.C166_SBX schema: (1) location_ext.searchable's StoreManager field pointed at x_StoreManager, but the actual SnowTime column has always been x_storemanagername — the same *ManagerName suffix every sibling manager field already uses; only StoreManager was missing it. (2) loyalty_card_ext.searchable / item_discount_ext.searchable declared MemberID as System.Int64 (the legacy pyardm NUMBER(38,0) type), while SnowTime's X_MEMBERID is an unsized TEXT column — confirmed clean, no malformed data (sampled all 2.2B+ non-null values). CodeAnt's PR review caught a follow-on gap: StarRewardTransactions.search and SVCactivity.search independently hardcoded Int64 for MemberID in their own Parameter/DisplayField/Condition/Variable elements, so the searchable-level fix alone wouldn't have resolved the search.

Fix is up in arpfiles PR !57459: corrected the StoreManager field name, retyped MemberID to System.String everywhere it's referenced (both searchables + both saved searches), and dropped the now-meaningless numeric range operators (greaterthan/between/etc.) that would sort MemberID lexicographically. Pending CI schema validation + review.

Internal note — escalation needed, Secure engineering (application code), not arpfiles

Verified: arpfiles PR !57459 is live on release. Confirmed directly on the release branch — StoreManager field name and MemberID type (System.String) are both correct in production for c166_sbx. The catalog fix is fully deployed and correct.

New failure found separately, same client — this matches what Nancy is now hitting on the drilldown (store 49996, partner 2389831):

Numeric value '1870125876697924' is not recognized
SqlState: 22018, VendorCode: 100038, QueryId: 01c74f01-0109-be1e-0120-d20105f2fa0f

Cause: DeaggregationEngine builds the drilldown query and still binds $deagg_loyalty_card_ext_memberid as an unquoted numeric literal (e.g. 70118851146), even though the catalog field is correctly typed System.String. This is Secure application code (DeaggregationEngine.cs), not a catalog/arpfiles config issue, so it's outside what this ticket's arpfiles fix can reach.

Explains Nancy's observation that only some Member IDs error: the implicit numeric cast only fails when a non-numeric-shaped value is present in the scanned group before the drilldown filter narrows it.

Escalating to Secure engineering to fix the numeric binding in DeaggregationEngine — keeping on this ticket per current process (no new ticket).
